```python
from pyscf import gto, dft
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np, os
smi='CNC1=CC(=O)COC1'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=42, useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
coords=[]
for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); coords.append(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.10f} {p.y:.10f} {p.z:.10f}')
atom='; '.join(coords)
mol=gto.M(atom=atom, basis='def2-svp', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol)
calc.xc='b3lyp'
calc.conv_tol=1e-9
calc.max_cycle=100
energy=calc.kernel()
moe=calc.mo_energy
occ=calc.mo_occ
homo=moe[np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]]
lumo=moe[np.where(occ==0)[0][0]]
gap=lumo-homo
print('SCF converged:', calc.converged)
print('Total energy (Ha):', f'{energy:.10f}')
print('HOMO (Ha):', f'{homo:.10f}')
print('LUMO (Ha):', f'{lumo:.10f}')
print('HOMO-LUMO gap (Ha):', f'{gap:.10f}')
print('Basis:', 'B3LYP/def2-SVP')
print('Geometry:', 'RDKit MMFF-optimized, neutral singlet')
```
